split_pipe_entrypoint.dataset_id: String (The unique identifier for the dataset.)
split_pipe_entrypoint.team_id: String (ASAP team identifier; used in batch_id.)

split_pipe_entrypoint.parse_runs.run_id: String (Parse run ID, e.g. PB-001; used in output names and cell IDs)
split_pipe_entrypoint.parse_runs.kit: String (Parse Bio kit: WT_mini, WT, WT_mega, WT_mega_384, WT_penta, WT_penta_384)
split_pipe_entrypoint.parse_runs.batch: String (SAMPLE.csv batch value for this run, e.g. Batch1)
split_pipe_entrypoint.parse_runs.sample_list_tsv: File (Parse sample name + round-1 wells, one per line)
split_pipe_entrypoint.parse_runs.sample_map: File? (optional; parse_sample,subject_id,sample_id; needed when a subject has more than one sample in the run)

sublibraries.sublibrary_id: String (e.g. PB-001-a; list sublibraries in the order vireo was computed on)

parse_samples.vireo_donor_ids: File? (pooled Parse sample: vireo donor_ids.tsv; set this or subject_id)
parse_samples.subject_id: String? (un-pooled Parse sample: its subject; set this or vireo_donor_ids)

split_pipe_entrypoint.genome_ref_tar_gz: File? (optional; prebuilt split-pipe mkref index. Supply to skip make_reference, omit to build one)
split_pipe_entrypoint.genome_fasta: File (only used when genome_ref_tar_gz is omitted)
split_pipe_entrypoint.genes_gtf: File (only used when genome_ref_tar_gz is omitted)
split_pipe_entrypoint.allen_brain_mmc_pr: File (MapMyCells precomputed stats for the taxonomy)
split_pipe_entrypoint.allen_brain_mmc_ma: File? (optional; marker gene lookup, skips on-the-fly markers)
